description: Configure protected users/roles, whitelisted roles/members, ignored channels and the notification message.

content.name: protectedRoles
content.description: Specific roles which are protected from pings.

content.name: protectAllUsersWithProtectedRole
content.humanName: Protect all users with a protected role
content.description: if enabled, all users with at least one protected role will be protected from pings, even if they are not specifically listed as protected users.

content.name: protectedUsers
content.description: Specific users who are protected from pings.

content.name: ignoredRoles
content.description: Roles allowed to ping protected members or roles.

content.name: ignoredChannels
content.description: Pings in these channels are ignored.

content.name: ignoredUsers
content.description: Pings from these users are ignored.

content.name: allowReplyPings
content.description: If enabled, replying to a protected user (with mention ON) is allowed.

content.name: selfPingConfiguration
content.description: Configure what happens when a protected user pings themselves. Note: Automod overrides this setting meaning this setting will not apply if Automod is enabled.
content: Get fun easter eggs when pinging themselves

content.name: enableAutomod
content.description: If enabled, the bot will utilise Discord's native AutoMod to block the message with a ping of a protected user/role. Warning: AutoMod does not support whitelisted categories due to limitations in Discord's AutoMod system - instead, it will still block the message but not log it in the history.

content.name: autoModLogChannel
content.description: Channel where AutoMod alerts are sent. It is recommended to keep these in a private channel.

content.name: autoModBlockMessage
content.humanName: AutoMod custom message for message block
content.description: Custom text shown to the user when blocked (Max 150 characters).
content.default: Your message was blocked because you are trying to ping a protected user/role. The message content might be logged depending on the configuration.

content.name: pingWarningMessage
content.description: The message that gets sent to the user when they ping someone.

params.name: pinger-id
params.description: ID of the user who pinged

default.title: You are not allowed to ping %target-name%!
default.description:
<@%pinger-id%>, You are not allowed to ping %target-mention% due to your role. You can view which roles/members you are not allowed to ping by using the `/ping-protection list protected` command.

If you were replying, make sure to turn off the mention in the reply.
